bigIdeas.en: The principles and processes underlying operations with numbers apply equally to algebraic situations and can be described and analyzed.
bigIdeas.zh: 数的运算背后的原理和步骤，同样适用于代数式，并且可以被描述和分析。

bigIdeas.en: Computational fluency and flexibility with numbers extend to operations with rational numbers.
bigIdeas.zh: 运算的熟练和灵活，扩展到有理数的运算。

bigIdeas.en: Continuous linear relationships can be identified and represented in many connected ways to identify regularities and make generalizations.
bigIdeas.zh: 连续的线性关系可以用多种相互关联的方式识别和表示，从中发现规律、归纳一般结论。

bigIdeas.en: Similar shapes have proportional relationships that can be described, measured, and compared.
bigIdeas.zh: 相似图形之间有成比例的关系，可以描述、测量和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Analyzing the validity, reliability, and representation of data enables us to compare and interpret.
bigIdeas.zh: 分析数据是否有效、可靠，以及呈现方式是否恰当，我们才能进行比较和解读。
